title: Young Man Makes The Biggest Mistake Of His Life & Has An Emotional Breakdown
description:
#news #police #arrest

On March 29, 2023. Officers were dispatched to a vehicle that was parked on the roadway with the driver asleep behind the wheel. The man had the vehicle in drive and his foot on the brake. When the officers approached him he was very confused and did not realize he fell asleep. He was identified as 21 year old Gabriel.
